title: Full app scaffolded from one detailed spec
summary: One long prompt specified the whole app -- aggregation, LLM fit scoring, resume/cover-letter tailoring, an application tracker, preference learning from feedback -- and Claude built milestones 1 through 6 (scaffold, manual scoring, feedback loop, automated source adapters, tailored generation, deploy artifacts) in one continuous pass.

title: Cold-start onboarding and a Shelf-Life-matched UI
summary: A guided first-run flow (resumes, desired role, company discovery, favorites) so a brand-new user isn't dropped into an empty digest, plus a UI overhaul matching Shelf Life's own design system and markdown rendering.

title: Flow redesign: guidance not filters, a real nav structure
summary: Titles/salary became scoring guidance rather than strict filters, job-board discovery broadened beyond named companies, and the app split into Digest / All Jobs / My Jobs / Manage Sources / Profile instead of one overloaded page.

title: Resumes edited in place as tracked changes, not rebuilt
summary: Diagnosed why generated resumes were consistently poorly formatted (the old generator rebuilt the whole document from a handful of cloned paragraphs) and replaced it with context-anchored edits applied as real Word tracked changes to the user's own template.

title: Live on Cloud Run, locked to one account via IAP
summary: Deployed to a dedicated GCP project with persistent storage for the database and uploaded resumes, Identity-Aware Proxy restricting access to one Google account, and a daily Cloud Scheduler job authenticated through IAP with a real signed identity.

title: Onboarding v2, Jobby interview-prep chat, email digests
summary: A substantial block of work from a Claude Code on the web session, merged straight into main: a rebuilt onboarding wizard, "Jobby" -- a saved per-job interview-prep chat -- email alerts for new high-interest matches, salary extraction, ATS auto-detection, and steerable discovery (free text or "find more like this").

title: Product Timeline and decision log, ported from Shelf Life
summary: Brought over the same system Shelf Life uses to show how it was built -- DECISIONS.md, the prompts/ export pipeline, and this Timeline page -- now that the app is private behind IAP rather than public, the reasoning that originally ruled it out no longer applies.
